segments.ja255:2.1: Yato ca kho bahutaraṃ, bhojanaṃ ajjhavāhari [ajjhupāhari (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja255:2.3: Tato tattheva saṃsīdi, amattaññū hi so ahu.
segments.ja255:3.1: Tasmā mattaññutā sādhu, bhojanasmiṃ agiddhatā [agiddhitā (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja255:3.3: Amattaññū hi sīdanti, mattaññū ca na sīdareti.
